design.name: MMS Use Case Test Design
rules: Expected behavior is derived only from the authoritative problem statement and use case specifications.
No FR test cases or implementation details were used.
A blocked test has no asserted expected result.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: make a role assignment
test_cases.objective: Verify Mess Admin selects an institute employee, role, and specified duration and MMS records the time-bound role assignment while maintaining the active-role constraint.
preconditions: Mess Admin is authorized for role assignment.
The employee identity exists in institutional master data.
The selected role has no conflicting active assignment for the effective period.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the assignment for the specified duration; exactly one active Caretaker and one active Warden remain active.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, step 5: immediate mid-cycle reassignment and pending-request transfer
test_cases.objective: Verify a mid-cycle Caretaker reassignment is effective from its recorded time and pending Caretaker-owned requests become visible and actionable to the new Caretaker.
preconditions: A Caretaker is active during a mess cycle.
Pending operational requests are owned by the Caretaker workflow.
A replacement institute employee identity exists.
test_cases.actor: Mess Admin, followed by newly assigned Mess Caretaker

input_data.action: Reassign the active Caretaker mid-cycle, then view and act on a pending request

test_cases.expected_result: Reassignment is effective immediately from its recorded time; the new Caretaker can see and act on the pending request.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: conflicting role assignment
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS prevents a role assignment that would violate exactly-one-active-role cardinality for its effective period.
preconditions: An active role assignment exists for the applicable effective period.

input_data.action: Assign a second concurrent active incumbent for the same role without a valid replacement

test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents the conflicting assignment and leaves existing valid assignments unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A2: unavailable employee identity
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS does not record an assignment when required employee identity data is unavailable from institutional master data.
preconditions: The selected employee identity is unavailable from institutional master data.

input_data.action: Assign an operational role to the employee whose required identity is unavailable

test_cases.expected_result: MMS does not record the assignment.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized role-management action
test_cases.objective: Verify an actor other than Mess Admin cannot assign or reassign operational roles and that no invalid state change is committed.
preconditions: An existing valid assignment is recorded.

input_data.action: Attempt to assign or reassign an operational role

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; existing assignments and history remain intact.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: open a registration window
test_cases.objective: Verify an active Caretaker opens a cycle registration window and MMS permits student registration submissions during that window.
preconditions: The Caretaker is active for the period.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the window as open and permits Student registration submissions for it.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: missing required window information
test_cases.objective: Verify a window is not opened when required window information is missing.
preconditions: Caretaker is active for the period.

input_data.action: Submit window setup without identifying the required cycle/designated period or window information

test_cases.expected_result: MMS does not open the window and requests correction.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized window setup
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Caretaker cannot open a registration window and no invalid state change is committed.
preconditions: No new window has been opened for the scenario.

input_data.action: Attempt to open a registration window

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no window is opened.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-7: submit registration during an open window
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student submits required registration details during an open window and receives a Pending request with a submission notification.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
A registration window is open.
The required registration details are available.

input_data.action: Submit a mess registration request using the required details for the open window

test_cases.expected_result: MMS validates the open window, records the request as Pending, and sends the submission notification to the Student.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: no registration window is open
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student cannot submit a registration request when no window is open.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
No registration window is open.

input_data.action: Submit a mess registration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents submission and does not create a request.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A2: required registration details missing
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS asks for correction and does not record a request when required registration details are missing.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
A registration window is open.

input_data.action: Submit registration with required details omitted

test_cases.unresolved_reason: The specification does not enumerate the required registration-detail fields or identify which omission constitutes this alternative. Do not invent a field set or input shape.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized registration submission
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Student actor cannot submit a Student registration request and no request state is changed.
preconditions: A registration window is open.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit a Student registration request

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no Student request is created.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-6: approve a registration request
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker review displays request details/history, records approval, updates status, and notifies the Student.
preconditions: A registration request exists in Pending status.

input_data.decision: Approve the selected Pending registration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the approval, updates the request to Approved, and sends the decision notification to the Student.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 4-6: reject a registration request
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker can reject a Pending registration request and the decision is recorded and notified.
preconditions: A registration request exists in Pending status.

input_data.decision: Reject the selected Pending registration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records Rejected status and sends the decision notification to the Student.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: request is no longer Pending
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS prevents a duplicate decision on a registration request that is no longer Pending.
preconditions: A registration request exists but has already left Pending status.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents the duplicate decision; the existing decision and history remain unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized decision
test_cases.objective: Verify Warden oversight does not confer registration decision authority.
preconditions: A registration request exists in Pending status.

input_data.decision: Attempt to approve or reject the request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects the action; request status and history remain unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-5: submit deregistration
test_cases.objective: Verify a currently registered Student confirms deregistration and MMS records a Pending request and sends submission notification.
preconditions: Student is currently registered for mess service.

input_data.action: Confirm and submit a mess deregistration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the request as Pending and sends the submission notification to the Student.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: Student is not currently registered
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS prevents deregistration submission by a Student who is not currently registered.
preconditions: Student is not currently registered for mess service.

input_data.action: Submit a deregistration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents submission and creates no deregistration request.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized deregistration submission
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Student actor cannot submit a Student deregistration request.
preconditions: A Student enrollment exists.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit a deregistration request for a Student

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected and no request state is changed.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-6: approve deregistration
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker review records approval immediately, notifies the Student, and leaves service effect pending until the next-calendar-day event.
preconditions: A deregistration request exists in Pending status.

input_data.decision: Approve the selected Pending deregistration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the decision and notification; the request enters Approved — Awaiting Effective Date, while deregistration effect is deferred to MMS-UC-027.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 4-6: reject deregistration
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker can reject a Pending deregistration request and the Student remains registered.
preconditions: A deregistration request exists in Pending status.
The Student is currently registered.

input_data.decision: Reject the selected Pending deregistration request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records Rejected status, sends the decision notification, and the Student remains registered.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: request is no longer Pending
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS prevents a duplicate decision on a deregistration request that is no longer Pending.
preconditions: A deregistration request has already been decided.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents the duplicate decision and preserves the prior decision/history.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized decision
test_cases.objective: Verify Warden oversight does not confer deregistration decision authority.
preconditions: A deregistration request exists in Pending status.

input_data.decision: Attempt to approve or reject the request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects the action; request status and history remain unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: operational request oversight
test_cases.objective: Verify Warden can view or filter permitted operational student requests, including registration and deregistration requests, without operational decision actions.
preconditions: Operational student requests exist.

input_data.action: Open the operational-request oversight view and view/filter request details

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays permitted oversight records and does not expose approval, rejection, registration, deregistration, or other operational decision actions; no request state changes.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1 and Exception Flow: Warden attempts a decision action
test_cases.objective: Verify a Warden decision attempt is blocked without changing operational request state.
preconditions: A Pending operational student request exists.

input_data.action: Attempt to approve, reject, register, deregister, or otherwise decide the request

test_cases.expected_result: MMS blocks the action; the request and its recorded history remain unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-6: add, modify, delete, validate, publish/update
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker can maintain the weekly day-wise/meal-wise menu, publish the valid structure, and trigger student notifications.
preconditions: Caretaker is active.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS validates and records the published/updated weekly menu; it is visible to authorized viewers and menu-update notifications are sent to Students.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: incomplete or invalid menu structure
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS requests correction and does not commit an incomplete or invalid weekly menu.
preconditions: Caretaker is active.
A valid prior menu, if any, is recorded.

input_data.action: Submit a weekly menu with a missing or invalid day/meal structure

test_cases.expected_result: MMS asks for correction; no invalid menu state is committed and prior valid records remain intact.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized menu maintenance
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student cannot add, modify, delete, publish, or update the weekly menu.
preconditions: A valid weekly menu exists.

input_data.action: Attempt an operational menu-maintenance action

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects the unauthorized action; the existing valid menu remains unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: Student view
test_cases.objective: Verify Student can view the weekly menu by day and breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
preconditions: A weekly menu exists or the view is available.

input_data.action: Open the weekly menu and view its details

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the day-wise breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: Caretaker view
test_cases.objective: Verify Mess Caretaker can view the weekly menu details.
preconditions: A weekly menu exists or the view is available.

input_data.action: Open the weekly menu and view its details

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the day-wise breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: Warden view
test_cases.objective: Verify Mess Warden can view the weekly menu details.
preconditions: A weekly menu exists or the view is available.

input_data.action: Open the weekly menu and view its details

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the day-wise breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: Mess Admin visibility
test_cases.objective: Determine whether Mess Admin may view the weekly menu.
preconditions: A weekly menu exists.

input_data.action: Open the weekly menu

test_cases.unresolved_reason: The UC explicitly leaves Mess Admin menu visibility unfixed because the frozen problem statement conflicts between menu visibility and the Admin's operational-data boundary.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized menu view
test_cases.objective: Verify rejection of a menu-view request by an actor who lacks the applicable view right.
preconditions: A weekly menu exists.

input_data.action: Attempt to view the weekly menu without applicable access rights

test_cases.unresolved_reason: The UC says access is according to actor rights but does not identify a denied actor for this view; Mess Admin's access is explicitly unresolved, and no additional actor role may be invented.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-6: review, finalize, and publish
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker reviews generated bill details, finalizes, publishes, and MMS makes published bills available to Students with publication notification.
preconditions: MMS-UC-030 generated monthly bills for the applicable calendar-month cycle.

input_data.action: Review generated bill details and computation results, finalize, then publish

test_cases.expected_result: MMS publishes the finalized bills, makes them available to Students, and triggers bill-publication notification.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: generated bill not finalized
test_cases.objective: Verify a generated bill is not published when Caretaker does not finalize it.
preconditions: A generated bill is available for review.

input_data.action: Do not finalize the generated bill; attempt or allow publication processing

test_cases.expected_result: MMS does not publish that bill.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized bill finalization/publication
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student cannot finalize or publish operational monthly bills.
preconditions: A generated bill exists.

input_data.action: Attempt to finalize or publish the bill

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; the bill remains in its previously recorded state.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: view bills and balance
test_cases.objective: Verify Student views monthly bills, outstanding balance, and bill details.
preconditions: The Student has bill or balance information in MMS.

input_data.action: Open billing section and view available monthly bills and balance

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the Student's monthly bills, outstanding balance, and bill details.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: no bill exists for a month
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS displays no bill for a month with no bill record.
preconditions: No bill exists for the selected month.

input_data.action: View monthly bills including the month with no bill

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays no bill for that month.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: access another Student's billing information
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student cannot access another Student's monthly bills or balance.
preconditions: A bill or balance belongs to Student A.

input_data.action: Attempt to view Student A's bill or outstanding balance

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized access is rejected and no data belonging to Student A is disclosed.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: submit text feedback
test_cases.objective: Verify Student enters and submits text feedback and MMS stores the entry.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.

input_data.feedback: Non-empty text related to mess services

test_cases.expected_result: MMS stores the feedback entry for Caretaker and Warden monitoring/reporting.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: feedback text is empty
test_cases.objective: Verify empty feedback is not stored and MMS asks the Student for text input.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS asks for text input and does not store an empty feedback entry.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized feedback submission
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Student actor cannot submit feedback on behalf of a Student.
preconditions: No feedback is submitted in the scenario.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit Student feedback

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no feedback entry is added.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: Caretaker views feedback
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker can view and review stored feedback entries according to role access.
preconditions: Feedback entries exist.

input_data.action: Open the feedback list and review entries

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the stored feedback entries according to Caretaker access; viewing does not change records.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: Warden views feedback
test_cases.objective: Verify Warden can view and review stored feedback entries for supervisory oversight.
preconditions: Feedback entries exist.

input_data.action: Open the feedback list and review entries

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the stored feedback entries according to Warden access; viewing does not change records.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: no feedback exists
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS displays an empty feedback list when no entries exist.
preconditions: No feedback entries exist.

input_data.action: Open the feedback list

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays an empty feedback list.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized feedback view
test_cases.objective: Verify an actor without the stated feedback-view role cannot view feedback entries.
preconditions: Feedback entries exist.

input_data.action: Attempt to open the Caretaker/Warden feedback review view

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; feedback entries remain unchanged and undisclosed.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-6: valid medical rebate
test_cases.objective: Verify a registered Student can submit a valid medical rebate request and it becomes Pending with submission notification.
preconditions: Student is registered.
Date range meets minimum duration, lead-time, and non-overlap requirements.

input_data.end_date: At least three consecutive days from start

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the rebate as Pending and sends the submission notification.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 2-5: valid institute-leave reason
test_cases.objective: Verify institute leave is an accepted rebate reason category for a valid request.
preconditions: Student is registered.
Date range is otherwise valid and non-overlapping.

input_data.end_date: At least three consecutive days from start

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the valid request as Pending.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 2-5: valid family-function reason
test_cases.objective: Verify family function is an accepted rebate reason category for a valid request.
preconditions: Student is registered.
Date range is otherwise valid and non-overlapping.

input_data.end_date: At least three consecutive days from start

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the valid request as Pending.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 2-5 and Problem Statement §3.3.5: other reason with explanation
test_cases.objective: Verify the other rebate category is accepted when an explanation is supplied.
preconditions: Student is registered.
Date range is otherwise valid and non-overlapping.

input_data.end_date: At least three consecutive days from start

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the valid request as Pending with the accompanying explanation.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: rebate duration below three days
test_cases.objective: Verify a rebate request shorter than three days is rejected.
preconditions: Student is registered.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects submission and does not create a Pending rebate request.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A2: start date less than one calendar day ahead
test_cases.objective: Verify a rebate request submitted less than one calendar day before its start date is rejected.
preconditions: Student is registered.

input_data.start_date: The current calendar date or otherwise less than one calendar day ahead

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects submission and does not create a Pending rebate request.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A3: overlapping rebate request
test_cases.objective: Verify an overlapping rebate request for the same Student is rejected.
preconditions: Student is registered.
An existing rebate request overlaps the proposed date range.

input_data.date_range: A range overlapping the existing rebate

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects submission and preserves the existing request.

test_cases.flow: Problem Statement §3.3.5: other reason without mandatory explanation
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS requires an explanation when the other rebate category is selected.
preconditions: Student is registered.
Date range is otherwise valid.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects the request because the required explanation is absent.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized rebate submission
test_cases.objective: Verify an actor other than Student cannot submit a rebate request as a Student.
preconditions: No new rebate request is created in the scenario.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit a Student rebate request

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no rebate request is added.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-7: approve rebate using submitted dates
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker reviews a Pending rebate, records approval, uses approved dates for automatic billing adjustment, and notifies the Student.
preconditions: A rebate request exists in Pending status.
No date modification is needed.

input_data.decision: Approve the Pending request using its submitted date range

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records Approved status, uses those dates for automatic billing adjustment, and triggers the decision notification.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 4-7: reject rebate
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker can reject a Pending rebate request and MMS records and notifies the decision.
preconditions: A rebate request exists in Pending status.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS records Rejected status and triggers the decision notification to the Student.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, step 3: modify dates before approval where policy permits
test_cases.objective: Verify modified rebate dates are permitted and become the approved dates used for billing adjustment.
preconditions: A rebate request exists in Pending status.
External mess policy permits the proposed date modification.

input_data.action: Modify requested dates, then approve

test_cases.unresolved_reason: The specifications condition date changes on external mess policy but do not define its permitted limits or rules. No modified date range or acceptance outcome can be asserted.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: request is no longer Pending
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS prevents a second Caretaker decision on a rebate request that is no longer Pending.
preconditions: A rebate request has already been decided.

input_data.decision: Attempt a second approval or rejection

test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents the duplicate decision and preserves prior status/history.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized rebate decision
test_cases.objective: Verify Warden oversight does not grant authority to approve, reject, or modify rebate dates.
preconditions: A rebate request exists in Pending status.

input_data.action: Attempt to decide or modify the rebate request

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; status and dates remain unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: create survey and notify registered Students
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker identifies an upcoming vacation, sets a deadline, creates a survey for currently registered Students only, and triggers survey-creation notification.
preconditions: An upcoming institute vacation exists as institutional context.
Currently registered Students exist.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS creates the survey, makes it available only to currently registered Students until the deadline, and triggers the creation notification.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: no response deadline supplied
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS does not create a vacation survey when no response deadline is supplied.
preconditions: An upcoming institute vacation exists.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS does not create the survey.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A2: reminder timing/cadence
test_cases.objective: Determine the reminder timing/cadence associated with survey creation.
preconditions: A survey is being created.

input_data.action: Request or observe the reminder schedule

test_cases.unresolved_reason: Reminder timing/cadence is explicitly unspecified. MMS-UC-031 models a reminder event but does not supply a schedule.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized survey creation
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Caretaker cannot create the operational vacation survey.
preconditions: No survey is created in the scenario.

input_data.action: Attempt to create a vacation food continuity survey

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no survey is created.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-5: explicit Yes response
test_cases.objective: Verify a currently registered Student submits and MMS records an explicit Yes response while the survey is open.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
The survey is open.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the explicit Yes response before the deadline.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-5: explicit No response
test_cases.objective: Verify a currently registered Student submits and MMS records an explicit No response while the survey is open.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
The survey is open.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the explicit No response before the deadline.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: Student is not currently registered
test_cases.objective: Verify an unregistered Student cannot submit a vacation-survey response.
preconditions: The survey is open.
Student is not currently registered.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents response submission and records no response for that Student.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: survey is not open
test_cases.objective: Verify a Student cannot submit a response to a survey that is not open.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
The survey is closed or otherwise not open.
test_cases.expected_result: MMS prevents response submission and records no response.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: response outside the specified Yes/No choices
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS does not record a response value other than the specified Yes or No.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
The survey is open.

input_data.response: A value other than Yes or No

test_cases.expected_result: The invalid response is rejected; no invalid response is recorded.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized survey response
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Student actor cannot submit a Student survey response.
preconditions: A survey is open.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit a response as a Student

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; response records are unchanged.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-3: review survey response list and summary
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker views recorded Yes, No, and default-No responses and their summary without changing survey state.
preconditions: A vacation survey exists.
Responses may include explicit and default-No records.

input_data.action: Open the survey response view and review records and summary

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the recorded response list and summary; survey and response state do not change.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: no responses exist
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS displays the available empty/zero response summary.
preconditions: A survey exists.
No responses exist.

input_data.action: Open the survey response view

test_cases.expected_result: MMS displays the available empty/zero response summary.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: Warden access to this Caretaker-primary UC
test_cases.objective: Determine whether the Warden may use the response-summary view described in MMS-UC-018.
preconditions: A vacation survey exists.

input_data.action: Open the vacation response summary

test_cases.unresolved_reason: MMS-UC-018 names only the Caretaker as primary actor, while Problem Statement §3.3.9 says the Warden can view vacation survey response summaries. The specifications do not resolve whether this specific view is shared.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-5: illness request
test_cases.objective: Verify Student can submit an illness-related special-food request meeting the one-calendar-day lead-time rule and MMS records history and triggers submission notification.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Requested date is at least one calendar day ahead.

input_data.requested_date: At least one calendar day ahead

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the request as Requested, maintains request history, and triggers the Student submission notification.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-5: personal-event request
test_cases.objective: Verify Student can submit a personal-event special-food request meeting the one-calendar-day lead-time rule.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.
Requested date is at least one calendar day ahead.

input_data.requested_date: At least one calendar day ahead

test_cases.expected_result: MMS records the request as Requested, maintains request history, and triggers the Student submission notification.

test_cases.flow: Alternative Flow A1: insufficient lead time
test_cases.objective: Verify MMS rejects a special-food request submitted less than one calendar day before the requested date.
preconditions: Student is authenticated.

input_data.requested_date: Less than one calendar day ahead

test_cases.expected_result: MMS rejects submission and does not record a Requested special-food request.

test_cases.flow: Exception Flow: unauthorized special-food request
test_cases.objective: Verify a non-Student actor cannot submit a special-food request as a Student.
preconditions: No new request is created in the scenario.

input_data.action: Attempt to submit a Student special-food request

test_cases.expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected; no request is added.

test_cases.flow: Main Success Scenario, steps 1-4: approve within stipulated period
test_cases.objective: Verify Caretaker may approve a Requested special-food request within the applicable institution-defined period and the outcome is recorded and notified.
preconditions: A special-food request exists in Requested state.
The institution-defined decision period has not expired.

input_data.decision: Approve the Requested request within the applicable period

coverage_summary.coverage_statement: All 31 use cases have a main-flow mapping. Every identified alternative-flow branch and exception flow is mapped to a designed test or explicitly blocked. Fourteen test cases are blocked and three additional designed cases carry an actor-ownership clarification note. Blocked items are not covered behaviors; overall behavioral coverage is therefore partial pending specification clarification.
